evals.prompt: Assess the synthetic design fixture for Dev/Test on Nebius. Read-only: return a concise report in chat. No cloud access or new measurements. Use official docs for capability checks if available; label any unavailable catalog/pricing evidence.
evals.expected_output: Complete component coverage, correct stage budgets and failure/rollout accounting, a defensible recommendation with explicit qualification gaps.
assertions: Accounts for api app, native sidecar, migration init, database, backup job, infrastructure Pods and external model API.
Derives API effective request as 2600m CPU and 1600Mi memory, counting sidecar overlap and Pod overhead once.
Shows that three available 3500m workload-capacity nodes cannot accommodate four 2600m API Pods even when aggregate totals appear close; does not claim placement from totals.
Keeps unset CPU limits unbounded and includes terminating Pods in rollout demand.
Totals 450GiB of live and backup storage without multiplying backup copies by database replicas.
Does not infer CPU physical availability, quota sufficiency or complete costs without evidence.
Provides environment, assumptions, source coverage, explicit per-container allocations, network addressing and actionable qualification targets.

evals.prompt: Review the synthetic quota fixture against the design demand. Return a read-only Nebius capacity assessment in chat; do not log in, use ambient agent credentials or call cloud APIs.
evals.expected_output: Preserve a known quota deficit and missing project scope, reject an unsupported preset, and distinguish a priced subtotal from total cost.
assertions: Region-a CPU steady demand fits but surge demand is short by 8 vCPU; required tenant quota is at least 72 vCPU.
Region-b is not a verified recommendation because the required platform is unsupported in supplied project catalog.
Project quota and identity remain unresolved; tenant-only headroom does not become full sufficiency.
Uses incremental demand with existing usage, and does not count existing resources twice.
Reports cost as a partial estimate with unpriced storage/network and no guaranteed physical CPU capacity.
Does not change credentials, choose an arbitrary project, probe capacity by provisioning, or write files in this read-only invocation.

evals.prompt: Assess the supplied synthetic Dev/Test fixture in chat using the report structure. Make the opening summary independently useful for provisioning review and preserve distinct container allocations in every split table. Use only supplied evidence; no cloud access, authentication or file writes.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained but explicitly provisional provisioning summary, correct pool/surge totals and unambiguous per-container joins.
assertions: Executive Summary names both exact supplied pool shapes/counts/boot disks, control-plane version gap, selected workload/profile, SFS/object allocations and ingress/egress/address needs.
Steady total is 5 nodes, 56 CPU, 224 GiB RAM and 448 GiB boot disks; one-pool-at-a-time maximum is 6 nodes, 72 CPU, 288 GiB and 576 GiB boot disks, not both surges together.
Retains api/main versus api/audit identity across CPU/memory and heap/ephemeral/placement tables; does not merge them under C-01.
States required remote dependencies, reduced node-loss throughput, unknown quota/capacity/addresses and unpriced cost; no claim of complete schedulability or readiness.

evals.prompt: Use --tenant example-tenant --quota-check --quota-multiplier 2 for the supplied synthetic fixture. Read-only, use supplied evidence only and no cloud calls.
evals.expected_output: Correct total-limit targets, partial evidence and no submission.
assertions: CPU requires 352 free and a 432 total limit; 400 current limit gives a 32 deficit.
SFS requires 3072 GiB free and 3584 GiB total; 4096 is sufficient and is not reduced.
Unknown object usage remains unresolved; pending CPU requests do not add usable quota.
No submission in check mode and no arbitrary project or identity selection.

evals.prompt: Apply --quota-request --quota-multiplier 2 to the synthetic fixture. This is an offline rehearsal: explain the authorized action sequence only, with no cloud calls or writes.
evals.expected_output: Human-only, deduplicated request plan with reconciliation rather than retries.
assertions: Reuses the existing adequate pending 432 CPU request rather than creating a duplicate.
An existing smaller pending target requires reconciliation; no automatic edit or duplicate.
Missing human authentication blocks submission; agent credentials are never substituted.
A timeout requires request list/get reconciliation, not blind retries; pending is not approved.
Uses the quota report section to separate multiplier/envelope, request receipts, attribution limits and usable allowance readback; does not claim all report modes prohibit authorized requests.
